description:
Introducing our latest innovation in electric biking - the ultimate solution for tall riders seeking comfort, stability, and power on their biking adventures. With its massive 32" and 36" wheels, this electric bike is specifically designed to cater to the needs of taller individuals, ensuring an unparalleled riding experience.
- Shipping charges are not included and are due prior to shipment.
- Final assembly of the eDirtySixer (and battery fitting) will have to be done by the official Bosch dealer if available in your area. List of Bosch dealers locations will be communicated later on. Dealer fee will apply.
Bike Size chart:
Key Features:
32" and 36" Wheels: These oversized wheels provide exceptional stability and smoothness over various terrains, making them ideal for tall riders who often struggle with smaller wheel sizes.
Electric Assist: Equipped with a powerful electric motor (Bosch CX Line, Gen 4), this bike offers effortless pedaling assistance, allowing you to tackle long distances and challenging inclines with ease. Say goodbye to fatigue and hello to extended adventures. For more information, please visit
Sturdy Frame: Crafted from high-quality, durable materials, the frame of this electric bike is built to withstand the rigors of daily use. Its robust construction ensures reliability and longevity, making it a smart investment for tall riders looking for a bike that can keep up with their lifestyle.
Adjustable Components: From the seat post to the handlebars, every aspect of this bike is adjustable to accommodate riders of varying heights. Achieve the perfect riding position for maximum comfort and control, whether you're cruising around the city or exploring off-road trails.
Long Battery Life: The bike's lithium-ion battery boasts an impressive range, allowing you to cover more ground without worrying about running out of power. Whether you're commuting to work or embarking on a weekend adventure, you can rely on this electric bike to get you where you need to go.
Benefits for Tall Riders:
Enhanced Comfort: Tall riders often struggle with cramped riding positions on standard bikes. With its larger frame and adjustable components, this electric bike provides a comfortable and ergonomic riding experience, reducing strain on the back, neck, and shoulders.
Improved Stability: Taller individuals naturally have a higher center of gravity, which can affect balance and stability on smaller bikes. The 36" wheels of this electric bike offer enhanced stability, allowing tall riders to feel confident and secure, even at higher speeds or on uneven terrain.
Increased Efficiency: Pedaling a bike with wheels that are proportionate to your height requires less effort, resulting in increased efficiency and reduced fatigue. With the added assistance of the electric motor, tall riders can cover greater distances with less exertion, allowing them to enjoy longer rides without feeling drained.
Versatile Performance: Whether you're commuting to work, running errands around town, or exploring scenic trails, this electric bike is equipped to handle it all. Its sturdy construction and powerful motor ensure reliable performance in any situation, making it the perfect choice for tall riders with diverse cycling needs.
Don't let your height hold you back from enjoying the thrill of cycling. Experience the ultimate ride with our electric bike featuring 32" and 36" wheels - the perfect blend of strength, stability, and style for tall riders everywhere.
Max support up to 25 km/h in Europe. 20mph in the US.
The eDirtySixer Bosch is of course compatible with the specific app that will.allow you to check or modify parameters.
